reviews.author: Telisha Collins
reviews.text: Chris & his crew did an awesome job, they cut down four trees that have been leaving me with a lot of mess to clean up for some years now. They also cut many branches down on other trees that were hanging too low. The boyz worked hard until the job was done and did a great clean up afterwards, plus gave me a great price compared to others. I def recommend My Tree Boyz if you are in need of tree removals.

reviews.author: Jason Skinner
reviews.text: Chris and his crew did an outstanding job for us. They removed several dead trees around our pool area and driveway, and also trimmed the trees along the front and side of our property. From the start, the experience was excellent. The crew showed up early, worked efficiently, and kept me informed throughout the entire process. What impressed me most was their attention to detail and professionalism. They completed the job quickly, cleaned up thoroughly, and left the property looking better than when they arrived. If you’re looking for a reliable, professional tree service that does quality work and stands behind it, I highly recommend Chris and his team. We couldn’t be happier with the results.

reviews.author: Chris Banks
reviews.text: Chris and his crew spent a day at my property. They were punctual, efficient, and cleaned up well afterward. I would 100% hire them again for any tree work in the future.

reviews.author: Mandy Read
reviews.text: So incredibly happy with this company! They are an amazing crew! Very respectful and honest! Highly recommend them to all of our patients, friends and family! Thank you

reviews.author: Janet Larsen
reviews.text: Second time I’ve used them. They do a great job. I had a massive oak tree to be removed and two cut down a lot of overhang from large trees always recommend them, especially for safety.

reviews.author: Angela Passarella
reviews.text: Quality work, respectful, professional with reasonable prices! We used this company for several tree removals! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Sandra Martin
reviews.text: Chris and his crew are absolutely top notch, they showed up 15 minutes early and took down some monster trees for us. Besides some tree dust it’s like they were never here, the whole crew was respectful and professional. Would highly recommend to anyone who ever needs a tree down. Thanks again My Tree Boyz!

reviews.author: Ellen Burven
reviews.text: Amazing Work! I Highly Recommend My Tree Boyz! From start to finish theywere Professional, Courteous, Knowledgeable and above all put Safety First at all times! Arrived on time, were quick yet careful. When they left everything was cleaned up and tidy. Chris was there for all my questions about what was needed to keep my property safe and still keep the healthy trees. My job was big, over 20 trees. I will definitely use them again if I have more that need to come down. They are really the BEST!!

reviews.author: Walt A
reviews.text: I had Chris and his crew remove 8 large trees from my property this past January. All but one of the trees was in my opinion a difficult job. Hanging overtop of structures, my neighbors property, and inaccessible to most equipment. These guys did an excellent job of removing the trees and cleaning everything up. I will definitely be using Chris and his crew in the future, and recommending him to anyone I know who needs tree work. Thank you again Chris!

reviews.author: MrMilesbmagee
reviews.text: Chris and his crew were very professional. Did clean and fast work. Cleaned up the yard really nicely. Easy to talk with and fair pricing.

reviews.author: Runnin Pretty
reviews.text: Chris and his crew showed up and went way above and beyond our expectations if removing trees around our carports. Great group of hard workers.

reviews.author: Marylu Hamilton
reviews.text: Chris and his team were great, on time did the work quickly and left no mess. They trimmed 2 trees and took out a large tree. They took the time to make sure they didn't damage any of my lawn when moving the trucks on my property and took great care of my concerns as well. Will be using them again. And recommending them to anyone who may need tree work. Best of all the proce was exelent.

reviews.author: TriState Investors
reviews.text: I had These guys take down a few trees. They went above and beyond and their pricing was very fair! Chris sticks to his word and get it done quick.

reviews.author: Justin Ramos
reviews.text: Highly recommend My Tree Boyz. Chris came out and thoroughly assessed my property. He addressed the trees I had needed removed, plus pointed out additional hazards of dead trees he suggested be removed. Chris was very communicative and stayed by his word. The crew was professional and did a great job. Would use them again and highly recommend them to anyone in need of services.

reviews.author: Darlene Williams
reviews.text: Today I had My Tree Boyz do some tree work at my home. We'll, these guys are really impressive. First, they were prompt, professional, and on point. They do not play. These guys know their craft. The whole crew went right to work; this is a no nonsense crew. We'll, I'm going to call them The Tree Artists. Working on those trees, they made it look so easy, though dangerous. They are very meticulous and skilled workers. They also do a wonderful job cleaning up, not leaving a speck. They made my home a Masterpiece. When you look at my property with all the trees manicured, all you see is a pretty picture. Thanks Chris and the Crew; I'll be seeing you again. You definitely have my business. And for what you do, no one can beat your prices.

reviews.author: Amanda Richardson
reviews.text: Chris & his crew are the best! We had our whole yard filled with huge trees that were taken down, cleaned up and stump grinded all in one day! They were extremely careful & cautious as some were near our garage and house. Would absolutely recommend them to everyone!

reviews.author: Tiffany Mitchell
reviews.text: So happy with the services I received. Chris came out quickly to give me a price and even came in the rain! The job was scheduled in a timely manner and they cleaned up my yard beautifully after they were done. Chris and the entire crew were professional and polite. They worked quickly and efficiently and did a better job than I ever could have imagined. I will definitely recommend them to all of my friends and family.

reviews.author: Mike Broyles
reviews.text: Chris was easy to work with and the entire crew did a fantastic job. We had one of the biggest, if not the biggest, tree on the block. Our street is moderately busy. They were like acrobats and did an excellent job downing that beautiful monster in a short amount of time and at a price that fit my budget. Cleaned up nicely as well. Gladly recommend them.

reviews.author: Jason Stant
reviews.text: My Tree Boyz did an amazing job removing the trees from my yard. The crew worked fast and efficient and were very professional. They removed all trees and branches from the property and raked up all of the debris from my yard. They gave me a great price that I couldn't refuse. Highly recommended. Thanks guys, great work!

reviews.author: OCNJ Girl
reviews.text: We called shortly after the last big thunderstorm, concerned with a tall tree that had several large limbs overhanging the roof. Every tree service was crazy busy at this time because so many trees came down in the storm, but Chris went out of his way to come give us an estimate, even coming early on a Sunday morning. The price he gave for cutting the limbs and trimming a second tree was very good. I feel like he went out of his way to squeeze us in among bigger jobs. His crew did a good job. I've already recommended them to my niece.

reviews.author: David D.
reviews.text: After some recomendations from others in town, I called Tree Boyz to remove 2 tree of heavens 1 dead and one dying from injury and lantern Fly infestation. They came in and did a great job while being both friendly and professional. Their work was also extremely fast, efficient, and competitive with those who charge a higher price. All in all I would recommend them to anyone in South Jersey needing tree services. Great job guys!

reviews.author: Martha Anderson
reviews.text: I've had this company to my house twice to have trees taken down and trimmed. They do a great job for a reasonable price, and they work fast! They're very conscious about stuff in your yard if you're trying to be careful about something else while trees come down.

reviews.author: Ariane Nunnciato
reviews.text: Called for an estimate and got back to me promptly. Came to trim our tree the same week and did a great job! Price very reasonable. Will recommend to others.

reviews.author: Zachary Mack
reviews.text: We had a great experience with My Tree Boyz. From the outset, Chris was friendly and straight forward. Gave us a great estimate to remove several dead pines, one large oak and some miscellaneous trimming around the property. The crew was on time, very professional, and did a great job cleaning up the yard. Chris walked me around to make sure everything had been done as we requested. Would definitely use these guys again!

reviews.author: Jessica VanLeer
reviews.text: Amazing job done by My Tree Boyz!! About 20 trees, clean up, stump grinding. They worked in the rain until dark. Came back the next business day to finish the job. Highly professional, hard working crew. Completely transformed my yard! I have already recommended to a few friends. I cannot thank them enough!

reviews.author: Jasper Baxter
reviews.text: Very professional and great value. The crew was very careful to preserve the property and the tree was down in a very short time. Highly recommend My Tree Boyz. They will be my first pick on any future needs.

reviews.author: Sandra Green
reviews.text: Excellent and professional! Prior to their on-time arrival, My Tree Boyz gave me a call letting me know that they were on their way. Very courteous workers. The owners gave me a time frame of when the work would be finished, and to my surprise, they completed ahead of schedule! Pricing was very fair for two trees and the foreman also took notice of nearby dead tree branches, which were removed. The tree logs were cut to size ready for my borough to pick up. Thanks so much My Tree Boyz!

reviews.author: steven jacob
reviews.text: Company is very professional! I called up in the morning because I had a tree that fell on my house. By the end of the day they took care of. Was quick with the estimate and service was incredible! I highly recommend these guys!

reviews.author: Nate Hollander
reviews.text: A tree fell on my house and this company was so fast to respond. They were ready to do the work the next day and even tarped the damaged areas of the roof so there wouldn't be further damage. They're experienced and knew the process dealing with insurance. These Boyz were professional, courteous, and efficient. I very happy and thankful for this service.

reviews.author: Melanie Ray
reviews.text: What a great, hard working bunch of boyz! Did an excellent job removing multiple trees, trimming trees, and grinding stumps. These guys left a neat pile of firewood for me, as requested, in my back yard. Wonderful work, will be referring this company to others. Thank you Chris, Bret, & all the Boyz!

reviews.author: Josh Harris
reviews.text: These guys are awesome. I had a huge tree in my back yard between my fence and pool. Also had a bunch of stumps I needed ground out. Hour and a half, everything is done. Couldn't recommend them any higher. If I could go e them 10 stars, I would. Best price around.

reviews.author: michele turse
reviews.text: Chris and all his guys were wonderful! Chris gave me an estimate on a Tuesday and three were out Friday morning 8 am and done by 2/2:30! Two trees, stumps grinded, and took everything away left my yard clean for a great price! Highly recommend My Tree BOYZ! Thanks guys

reviews.author: Nicole Arellano
reviews.text: Came out the day after I called for an estimate to take down an 80+ ft Pine tree that lost a lot of branches after snow/ice storms. After getting 5 other estimates they were BY FAR the cheapest! Called again to set up appt for service for a few days later. .Owner called me same day and told me they could squeeze me in the next morning which was perfect because the tree was keeping my kids from being able to play out in the yard. They were in and out in about 2 hours! Great service! Highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Shawn Peck
reviews.text: Do not hire these guys. They did more damage then good. They dropped a tree into my pool. They damaged multiple sections of my fence. They damaged my neighbors fence. They damaged an electrical receptacle and never made good on the repair. We only went with these guy because they were referred by A Omega fence. I usually never go with the low bid. These guys are the low bid for a reason, they are complete hacks. Hopefully A Omega fence will think twice before referring this sham operation. I can only imagine what their insurance is like. The day after they cashed my check the owner was crying about how he paid his crew and didn’t have money for HIS bills. Really?! Your in business for yourself but cry about the time it takes for a check to clear? Word of advice... Keep money in your business account and the bank will make funds available. Also, when you say you will “Fix” something, actually follow through and do it. Be more respectful of people property. Your drugged out crew could care less.This is the worst tree service company in south jersey.

reviews.author: Lance Cohen
reviews.text: Had My Tree Boyz take down 6 trees, and trimmed up a bunch of branches. They were very quick, and did a great job. I would recommend them to anybody.

reviews.author: Brianna Ballinger
reviews.text: Chris was so easy to work with. He came out and gave us an estimate for a dead 12" pine tree, cut down and stump ground, and said he could handle 2 other stumps we had while he was there. By far the lowest prices of anyone else around. A couple other companies told us over $1200 and he wasn't anywhere near that! He and his crew came out about a week later and handled the dead pine, 2 additional stumps, as well as a third stump all for the same cost. No hidden fees. The guys were all respectful of our property, cleaned everything up, and made sure everything was good before leaving. One of the guys even went out of his way to make sure that myself as well as my kids (playing on their swing set) moved far enough away, so that we didn't get hit by any debris from the stump grinder. I highly recommend My Tree Boyz for all of your tree removal needs!

reviews.author: Helen Pierce
reviews.text: I had a tree break and fall on my sons playset. I called My tree boyz on Thursday, they came out Sunday morning and had the job completed and cleaned up before noon on Tuesday. They did an amazing job and had the best price out of 4 different companies!! I will be using them for all of my future tree service needs and reccomend them to everyone I know.

reviews.author: Debra Pullaro
reviews.text: Great job! Very professional. They removed some very large trees and had to deal with some wasps and three hives in one of them. I couldn't ask for a better crew of guys. I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a tree service. Thanks again!

reviews.author: Teresa Lynn
reviews.text: very satisfied! Responded right away, completed the job fast, and had our yard looking cleaner than it was when they got here! No hassle, great prices, and wonderful people! Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Josh Vannais
reviews.text: Had them swing by my house and trim up some large trees and take some stuff out. They were fast and efficient. They did a great job and would hire them again for any other work I’d need. A+ quality work.

reviews.author: G Mail
reviews.text: Accidents do happen but it is what you do afterwards really matter. The worker failed to inform homeowner of damages. He was hoping it would be left unnoticed. Fortunately, homeowner noticed and confronted the owners. ( it was like pull a tooth) Eventually, an agreement were able to be achieved but it wasn't easy. If integrity is not important then this is a perfect company for you.

reviews.author: Brittany Fichetola
reviews.text: Great crew, they were quick and efficient and did an awesome job! If you need tree work done, this is definitely the best company to use, highly recommend!

reviews.author: nick pawlow
reviews.text: We used this company twice to remove some large trees and grind the stumps. Super job! Neat, clean and very professional and great prices. Highly recommened.

reviews.author: Michael Dehart
reviews.text: Chris and his crew showed up on time, did what they had to do quick and safe, cleaned up, and were on their way. Couldn't have had a better experience! Highly recommend Chris and his guys!!

reviews.author: Sara Reader
reviews.text: Chris and his crew were quick to respond and quick to service. Overall best estimates and they did great work. Will definitely be using them for all future services.

reviews.author: Joe Rost
reviews.text: This is the second time I Used My Tree Boyz at my house. If you call anyone else you're a foolish. They are the best around grate prices even better service. Clean and very professional.

reviews.author: Mike Miller
reviews.text: Removed large tree from back yard in a tight space, ground the stump, cleaned and finished area. Will use again and highly recommend.

reviews.author: kimi inkster
reviews.text: They just did a job at my house and were incredible! They are extremely quick and professional. Excellent experience overall. Thank you!

reviews.author: Ediana Aponte Martinez
reviews.text: I would not hire anyone else. They came and did their job on time and cleaned up well. I can’t be anymore satisfied. Thank you!

reviews.author: Liz Caruso
reviews.text: Awesome job! Quick response and estimate. Job completed right away. So pleased and will be using services again very soon. Thanks again guys!

reviews.author: Tuna Toy
reviews.text: Called and made appointment and then waited 2 weeks for that appointment, only to have no one show up, no call, nothing, total waste of my time.

reviews.author: Phil Pollock
reviews.text: They were unbelievably great!!!! They are very professional and affordable!!!! I recommend them and stand behind them 100%!!

reviews.author: steve kenney
reviews.text: FAST, POLITE ,SKILLED ,SAFE , REASONABLE , BEYOND REASONABLE. DON'T TAKE MY WORD FOR IT. GET SOME ESTIMATES THEN MAKE YOUR LAST CALL TO THE TREE BOYZ
